issues.detail: The Hebrew text says 'Elhanan son of Dodo' (אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן דּוֹדוֹ), but the Vietnamese renders 'Ên-ha-nan con trai của Đô-đô' — this is correct. However, the Hebrew says 'A-xa-ên' is not present; the Hebrew has 'אֲחִי יוֹאָב' meaning 'brother of Joab' without naming him. The Vietnamese adds 'A-xa-ên' (Asahel) as the name of the brother, which is an addition not in the Hebrew text.
